notes.title: v1.1.0 Performance Improvements + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]OPTIMIZATIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] BONES - Number of bones spawned is now capped to prevent bogging down the game in long matches.
[*] DINOSAURS - Improvements to dinosaurs to improve performance when using maximum numbers allowed in spectator mode
[*] GPU - Improvements to under the hood UE rendering, especially on the denser foliage maps.
[*] PARTICLES - Move more particles over to the GPU to reduce their bogging down the game.
[*] ARENAS - Hand combed through arenas to remove clipping and unnecessary foliage to further improve ease of rendering.
[/list]

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
[list]
[*] DODGE - Dodging now aligns with your camera to make more purposeful movements and better keep track of your dinosaurs orientation
[*] PARTICLES - Mouth blood now inherets it's velocity from the dinosaurs head creating more realistic splattering effects
[*] IMPACT PARTICLES - Impact particles now implemented on all levels
[/list]

[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
[list]
[*] YANGCHUANOSAURUS - Improved Head Movement and fixed offset jaw
[*] ALLOSAURUS - Improved Head Movement and fixed offset jaw
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIX[/h3]
[list]
[*] EATING WEAPONS - No more infinitely eating weapons to gain health.
[*] GENEREAL - Fixed various small errors and warnings
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.9 Training Mode + Tutorial Remake
notes.content:
[h3]NEW MODE[/h3]
+ TRAINING MODE - Brand new mode for practicing combat and testing out mechanics in a low pressure situation vs a Dummy or NPC enemies. Loads of options to customize the experience to your liking.

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ REMADE TUTORIAL IN TRAINING - Remade the main game tutorial to be more objective based, walking you through each mechanic one at a time and moving to the next one only upon completion.

+ IMPACT EFFECTS - Currently only on the Shoreside arena, testing body impact effects on walls and trees. Will expand to other maps if all goes well.


[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
+ ADJUSTMENT - Increased Parasaurolophus dodge distance.

+ SKINS - Added 3 new Styracosaurus skins.

+ SKINS - Added 2 new Pachycephalosaurus skins.

[h3]BUG FIX[/h3]
+ ATTEMPT - Potential fix for the Fatal Error some players have been experiencing during combat

notes.title: 1.0.8 Control Scheme Rework: Unified Secondary Attack
notes.content:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ BIG CHANGES TO THE CONTROL SCHEME PLEASE READ THE CONTROLS SECTION BELOW

+ Tail whips are now controlled directionally and telegraphed by a wound up tail. This will hopefully make them much more purposeful in their usage

[h3]CONTROLS[/h3]
+ SECONDARY ATTACK - Stomp and Tail Whip has been combined into a single button now known as secondary attack. This is a quick charge up attack that deals a large amount of stun and hits in a larger area than the basic attack

+ SECONDARY ATTACK - Right Click Button and Right Trigger now perform your secondary attack

+ TARGETING - Targeting has been moved to the Middle Mouse Button / Tab and Press Right Joystick on controller

+ BACK DODGE - While not moving, Spacebar and A Button will now perform a backwards dodge, gaining distance from your enemys quickly.

[h3]AUDIO[/h3]
+ Dinosaur vocalizations now interrupt each other, this stops a single dinosaur from having double audio and reduces the noise levels of the game feeling too cluttered

notes.title: 1.0.7 Cheeky Tail Swingers Buff
notes.content:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ Greatly increased the tail swing hit window to better match the animation/physics
+ Increased tail swing hitbox by 10%
+ Increased tail swing damage by 10%
+ Increased all species stamina regeneration by 12%


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
+ The animations for getting hit were interrupting tail swing animations, basically stunlocking tail swingers. This issue has been solved.

notes.title: v1.0.6 Nighttime Arena Variations
notes.content:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ Greatly reduced time before you can move after being revived

+ Added an invincibility window after being revived to avoid being quickly killed again

+ Grabbing weapons should be much easier

+ Added a Camera Zoom modifier to the mouse wheel


[h3]ARENAS[/h3]
+ All Arenas now have a nighttime variation!


[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
+ Adjusted Allosaurus's animations and camera values as a baby

[h3]UI[/h3]
+ Daytime / Nighttime Toggle now available in Arena Select.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes: QoL Arena Bounds + Nav Improvements
notes.content:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ Pathfinding altered to hopefully reduce dinosaurs getting stuck in rocks and other odd places in the maps

+ Re-made the invisible walls that keep dinosaurs in the arena to hopefully eliminate dinosaur getting stuck outside the ring or inside the entrance tunnels

[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
+ Compy added a better clinging animation and improved physics, hopefully reducing incidents of falling through the ground

+ Protoceratops received a large buff to it's headbutt damage and stun as well as a moderate buff to its basic attack

+ Sarcusuchus got a massive health buff


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
+ Insect eating had a glitch causing it to miss a LOT, it should be WAY easier to eat insects now

[h3]AI[/h3]
+ Small efficiency improvements

notes.title: Pouncing Overhaul
notes.content:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ Pouncing is now a charge up attack, giving more control over jump distance

+ Pouncing on a dinosaur adds an initial stun amount based on charge up

+ Pouncers now add Stun over time while clung to a dinosaur, knocking them over once full

+ Dismounting from a clung onto state, or knocking a dinosaur over while clinging, both now result in your Pouncers landing on its feet instead of being knocked over as well

+ Improved placement and rotation of clinging dinosaurs

+ Increased target lock on radius to make it easier


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
+ Fixed conflicting code that was resulting in animal diverting their aim when attacking, all dinosaur attacks should be much more accurate


[h3]UI[/h3]
+ Fixed typo in T. Rex description


[h3]AI[/h3]
+ Animals will no longer chase indefinitely before attacking, after a period of time they will divert their movement

+ Improved behavior of dinosaurs with clingers attached

notes.title: v 1.0.3 Death to the Headbutt Meta
notes.content:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ Reworked headbutts to be a charged style attack with scaling damage based on both time and speed. Each species has it's own unique base charging rates.

+ Reworked headbutt hitbox detection, should be much easier to land headbutts.

+ Headbutts now also hit downed animals.

+ Improved fluidity of sprinting movement that would sometimes be lost when changing directions.

[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
+ Increased Triceratops speed 10%

+ Fixed some funky movement visuals on the Pachycephalosaur

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
+ Removed ability to eat live dinosaurs with health remaining

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes: Attack Patterns
notes.content:
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
+ Major rework of the basic attack to unique patterns per species. Attacks are now grouped into combination patterns ending in a stronger attack
+ Stunned dinosaurs are now able to be picked up while still alive when they are in their VULNERABLE state
+ Made all dinosaurs able to carry atleast one CLINGER (dinosaur who has pounced on it) to stop animals from just instantly falling over
+ Fixed some faulty code that was making the Compy an absolute chore to beat.

[h2]DINOSAURS[/h2]
+ Reduced Yangchuanosaurus, Suchomimus, Spinosaurus, and Giganotosaurus size by 10%

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
+ Full rebalancing of all dinosaurs due to base mechanic change
Smaller dinosaurs were the primary recipients of a buff from the basic attack rework, having lower cooldowns and longer patterns allowed me to increase their overall damage output while maintaining their lower base damage befitting their small size
+ Increased Deinocheirus basic attack damage by 30%
+ Greatly increased damage done by headbutts on PRIMARY headbutters like Pachy, and Parasaur, as that should be their main source of damage (not just stun)

[h2]AUDIO[/h2]
+ Shortened Dimetrodon's attack sounds
+ Reduced Yangchuanosaurus attack volume 20%


[h2]AI[/h2]
+ Increased difficulty with use of the Attack Patterns. More punishing for not getting out of the way once the pattern starts

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Small QoL Changes
notes.content:
Gameplay:
+ Reworked Arena entrances to block all dinosaurs from re-entering once they've left, this should prevent fights from ending up in the dark fog
+ Widened Arena entrances to prevent larger dinosaurs from getting stuck
+ Ascension: Anky, Dime, and Sarc falling through the map on hatch fixed

Dinosaurs:
+ Straightened Sarcosuchus basic attacks to be more accurate 

Balance:
+ Nerfed the Styracosaurus by 10% across all values.

Audio:
+ Lowered Dimetrodon vocalizations by 20%
+ New Sarcosuchus attack sounds

UI
+ Fixed blurry text on the Character Select screen
+ New Font and Sizing for Input Icons to make them more readable
+ Scroll Wheel and Right Joystick will now rotate your Dinosaur in the Character Selection screen
+ Click your Dinosaur in the Character Selection screen will take bites out of them
+ Added a button mash indicator for getting up faster and shaking off Clingers
